quemSomos.title: Polar Group
quemSomos.subtitle: The right product when you need it most
quemSomos.paragraph1: Founded in 1992 in Macaé, Rio de Janeiro, Polar Group is a supplier of electrical, electronic and automation components, with specialized operations in hazardous areas and explosive atmospheres.
quemSomos.paragraph2: We work with "Ex" materials from the world's leading manufacturers. Present in 3 Brazilian states and in Europe, our team is trained and committed to customer success, ready to deliver anywhere.
quemSomos.missionText: To supply excellence in electrical, electronic and automation components for hazardous areas, ensuring safety and reliability for our customers.
quemSomos.visionText: To be the national reference in supplying "Ex" materials, recognized for technical quality and commitment to the highest safety standards.
values: Commitment to the customer and on-time delivery
